workarounds.symptom: Keep grading and goal drafting going when one of their file tools fails
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(grading): a failing file tool costs one tool result, not the whole grading. Target files: EvoScientist/middleware/goal.py, EvoScientist/middleware/rubric.py, tests/fakes/rubric.py. When one of the grader's (or the goal drafter's) file tools raised, the whole grading run died with `grader_error` — the criterion that tool concerned was lost, along with every other criterion the grader could still have decided. (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/777)

workarounds.symptom: Closing the terminal leaves the WebUI front-end running, and the next launch exits
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(webui): stop the front-end when the terminal closes. Target files: EvoScientist/deploy/server.py, EvoScientist/deploy/stop_signals.py, EvoScientist/deploy/webui.py. . Reuse deploy's signal guard from #812 around WebUI startup, readiness and polling. SIGHUP now reaches front-end cleanup, inherited ignored SIGHUP stays ignored for nohup, and a finally stops the front-end before returning or raising. The shared backend stays running after a completed launch. A closed terminal's output error cannot skip cleanup. (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/829)

workarounds.symptom: Channel replies and stream-json join a turn's messages without a separator
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(stream): preserve message boundaries in joined responses. Target files: EvoScientist/stream/events.py, EvoScientist/stream/state.py, tests/test_graph_gateway.py. Add blank-line separators at root assistant message boundaries in the emitted text deltas, keeping the processor, StreamState, standalone channel buffer and done.response aligned. Count inserted separators in discarded-text bookkeeping, flush pending selector text before ending the message, and avoid adding extra blank lines when a boundary already cont... (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/819)

workarounds.symptom: Interrupting `EvoSci deploy` shutdown can leave the server running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deploy): always stop the deploy server, and let EvoSci server stop end one its deploy left. Target files: EvoScientist/cli/server_cmd.py, EvoScientist/deploy/server.py, EvoScientist/langgraph_dev/manager.py. . Part of #796. (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/812)

workarounds.symptom: On Windows, file tools refuse drive paths inside the workspace and put Git Bash paths in a nested folder
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(files): let Windows file tools take drive and Git Bash paths. Target files: EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py, EvoScientist/backends.py, EvoScientist/middleware/__init__.py. On Windows the agent's shell and Python print host paths: `[REDACTED]\...` (Python, `$PWD`), `C:\Users/me/...` (Git Bash `pwd`), `[REDACTED]/...` (`pwd -W`) or `/c[REDACTED]/...` (`realpath`, `readlink -f`, `$HOME`). The agent hands them to the file tools. On `main`, deepagents' `validate_path` refuses every drive path inside the tool, even one ... (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/764)

workarounds.symptom: ask_user answers cannot resume a step with more than one pending interrupt

Target files: EvoScientist/gateway/server.py, EvoScientist/stream/events.py, tests/test_gateway_message_turns.py. , together with #748 (the interrupt-id part). (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/757)
